allowed_inputs: terminal_action_feature_keys outputs that pass the central firewall
exact waypoint/fence success labels for training and grading
fixed-seed black uniform legal replies for rollout evaluation
baselines: sealed flat learned Stage A baseline from Phase 2.9a
causal ablation with discovered structure removed
forbidden: hidden terminal aliases and old terminal-only aliases
hand-authored approach resolver as candidate generator
grown_structures: primitive atom TERMINALs keyed by sealed terminal/action atoms
failure-localized finite quorum SCRIPTs over those atoms with k=n confirmation
trial-routed quorum SCRIPTs with capped advisory initial weights
M4-successor promoted quorum units accepted only on positive heldout ablation delta
a root dispatcher that scores moves by confirmed learned atoms/quorums
meaning_of_autonomous_discovery: The probe enumerates legal actions from frozen approach-rung starts, observes only sealed terminal/action keys, mines atomic terminals, spawns finite k-of-n quorum SCRIPTs from failure-localized percept clusters, immediately routes them with a low advisory initial weight, prunes harmful composites, and uses only heldout counterfactual ablation deltas to mature composite quorums for move selection. The hand approach skill is used only as an outcome labeler/ceiling, never as a candidate generator or learner-visible feature source.
success_definition: Useful if discovered topology beats fallback/random, leaks zero keys, and ablation reduces heldout conversion. Competitive if it reaches the sealed flat learned baseline band.
